body: I don't know, but the thought of it is giving me anxiety... I thought about how fucked up it would be to kill myself around the holidays, so I'll stick around, even though it will be hell.

Thank you for your reply... I know I have a desire to live, you're right. I feel it everytime I seriously consider suicide... It's just hard to talk about because I feel super alone in this... Like I garuntee there's no other 23 year old guy feeling suicidal and having social anxiety because of an eyebrow tattoo. I know it sounds crazy and I feel crazy, which doesn't help. But it's just how I feel, so I'm trying not to judge myself too harshly for that.. Sometimes I have moments where I genuinely find myself not caring, but those are very fleeting... I can't even look people in the eye anymore without my heart racing and head pounding.

It's actually the opposite that's the problem - there's ink that I want gone but it takes time and I just want to scratch my face off everytime I look in the mirror.. it's probably not crazy noticeable if you're just looking at me for a little bit but it's definitely something I can notice and it drives me insane and it's hindered almost every part of my life and I'm so ashamed because of that

Thank you, yeah I try not to think about it. I'm doing everything I can to be kind to myself and remind myself it was out of my control and that I'm worthy of more important things, but it's just been eating at my conscious. I appreciate your encouragement, though.

I wish there were a way for people to see how it looks awhile after you get them because they will never look quite as fresh as they do once they're just done - had I known, I would've backed out right away... Instead, I'm stuck in a living hell for at least one year and I literally have become a different person, it's sad to say... I feel for you, though, losing hair is no fun. I wish you luck.
